name: DESAR QI Grade Reading
description: Grade count readings on a Quality Inspection. One row per grade. Replaces the hardcoded custom_grey_qty_a, custom_grey_qty_b, custom_grey_qty_c etc. fields. When a new grade is added in DESAR Settings, it automatically appears here.

fields.label: Grade
fields.description: Grade code from DESAR Grade Configuration. e.g. A, B, C

fields.label: Label
fields.description: Grade label. e.g. Premium, Standard, Scrap

fields.label: Qty
fields.description: Number of pieces in this grade. Inspector fills this.
